text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> inferpool-eu-west node group 'infer-eu-03' showing 15% NotReady nodes over 5m, increasing pod evictions, several model-worker pods OOMKilled and one GPU driver restart observed. Priority: P1 :rotating_light:

sara: seeing the same in metrics, p95 latency spiked to 1.8s for hosted-api routes, a couple of active customers reporting 504s.

ryan: I’m oncall, grabbing logs. Can we stop scheduling new inference pods to that node group?

anita: on it — cordoning nodes now to stop new pods: `kubectl cordon infer-node-0{3..6}.eu-west`

mike: quick context: we had a driver rollout yesterday, might be related. nvml reports `GPU reset` on node infer-node-05. Also saw container crashloop with `std::bad_alloc` in model-worker v2.

ryan: ok cordon success. Starting drains for the worst nodes to shift traffic. `kubectl drain infer-node-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

anita: draining but pods stuck terminating, kubelet on those nodes is restarting intermittently. Logs show `kubelet: OOM killer invoked` and then `kubelet: process crashed` repeatedly.

infra-bot: Observability note -> autoscaler detected increased pending pods in eu-west and triggered 2x burst capacity group (reserved) at 5760012360.

sara: customers A and C reported increased error rates, marking them as impacted. Notifying CS. Can we failover traffic to smaller quantized model v1 until pool stabilizes?

ryan: yes, initiate routing fallback. Pushing canary policy: route 100% of infer-eu-west traffic for hosted-api -> model-v1-quantized until further notice.

anita: moving 120 pods out of infer-eu-03, but we’re seeing `container runtime: failed to create containerd task: OCI runtime create failed: error while creating container` on one node — may be kernel/driver flakiness.

mike: preemptive mitigation: blackhole the faulty node NICs and reboot via BMC. Filed reboot job for infer-node-05 and infer-node-06. ETA ~ 6 minutes.

infra-bot: Reboot jobs submitted to rack controller. Node infer-node-05 transitioned to REBOOTING at 5760012369.

sara: good. Keep traffic routed away. Ryan, can you open a short incident note for customer comms? I'll draft the advisory.

ryan: opening incident doc now. Quick checklist: 1) maintain routing fallback 2) finish drains 3) monitor CUDA driver restarts and OOM rate 4) escalate to kernel/driver team if reboots don't help.

anita: drain finished for infer-node-06, infer-node-05 still in terminating loop, kubelet keeps crashlooping after container runtime error. Capturing `journalctl -u kubelet -o short-precise` and uploading to incident doc.

mike: NV driver stacktrace points to `nv-hostengine` errors and `GPU reset due to heartbeat timeout`. Suspect a driver/firmware mismatch in that rack.

sara: switching to postmortem mode once stable. For now, routing fallback is holding p50/p95 near normal for most customers. CS alerted and we've provided ETA ~ 30m.

infra-bot: Nodes infer-node-05 and infer-node-06 marked REBOOTED at 5760012376 and rejoined cluster at 5760012378. Health checks show infer-node-05 kernel logs clean; kubelet stable on restart.

ryan: thanks team. Leaving this thread open until we validate 30m of stable metrics. If OOMs reappear, escalate to drivers-team @drivers-team. :thumbsup:
